control_selection: earlier publisher-normal windows, >=6h apart, 20 nearest first-hour six-channel means in fitting-SD units
sequence_inventory: 7 readings, 150–450s steps; full-union availability upper bound, not model scoring
groups: overlapping six-hour precursor windows; not verified independent failures
limitations: Descriptive post-selection analysis, no p-values; control means may be poorly matched; source-normal windows are selected and calendar-shifted.
